fusions.name: Pasteboard Stampede
fusions.desc: Drives a herd of folded oxen ahead of you across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 14 damage to every enemy in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: The Sealed Bull
fusions.desc: Brings a sealed edict down on the target, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Vellum Coat
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Branded Tally
fusions.desc: Every hit you land brands a tally mark on that enemy, up to 10. At 10 marks they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per mark (272% at full). Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.
